idea.placeholder: เช่น เธอหยิบครีมมาทาหน้า / เด็กนั่งเล่นของเล่น / ยืนอธิบายโทรศัพท์รุ่น...

product.usageInstructions.help: Optional verified usage steps. If absent, the agent may infer category-level steps but must mark the evidence level.

product.mechanismFacts.help: Verified facts about how the product works. Useful for appliances, electronics, HVAC, cleaners and tools.

agentExecutionProfile.help: Same workflow contract; changes how many specialist roles are consolidated per model call.

format.shotDurationPolicy.help: Controls logical shot durations. Provider generation may split one logical shot into multiple temporal segments when needed.

assets.referencePurposes.help: หนึ่ง reference สามารถมีหลายหน้าที่ เช่น วิดีโอเดียวใช้ล็อก motion + camera + temporal rhythm หรือ audio ใช้ล็อก voice timbre + delivery.

assets.providerUsePolicy.help: กำหนดว่า reference ต้องถูกส่ง raw ถึง provider หรืออนุญาตให้วิเคราะห์เป็น structured guidance / ใช้เฉพาะ post-production ได้.

promotionTarget.help: ปล่อย Auto ได้ ระบบจะตัดสินจาก Idea + Start Frame + ภาพฉาก/สถานที่ + ภาพสินค้า ว่าเป้าหมายคือสินค้า ร้าน/สถานที่ บริการ ประสบการณ์ หรือไม่มีสิ่งที่โปรโมต

missingTargetAssetPolicy.help: กำหนดวิธีทำงานเมื่อไม่มีภาพสินค้าหรือ reference ของสิ่งที่กำลังโปรโมต

placePromotionPolicy.help: สำหรับรีวิว/ชมร้าน/สถานที่ กำหนดว่าจะพูดเฉพาะสิ่งที่มองเห็น ยอม research ข้อมูลเพิ่ม หรือขอภาพมุมอื่นก่อน

providerOptions.grokImagineVideo15.help: Grok 1.5 has separate Image-to-Video (Start Frame) and Reference-to-Video modes. The UI must show which mode will actually be sent and must never silently mix them.

providerOptions.wan3.help: Wan 3.0 รองรับ hard first/last frame และ multimodal refs แต่สอง family นี้ห้ามผสม raw ใน request เดียว; Video input ต้องผ่าน input+output <=30s preflight.

providerOptions.flux3.help: FLUX 3 public API ใช้ภาพ I2V เป็น literal keyframes ใน timeline ไม่ใช่ soft identity/style refs; character/product refs ควร prebake เป็น shot keyframe หรือ derive/fallback.

providerOptions.seedance.help: Seedance 2.0 และ 2.5 มี capability ต่างกันมาก: 2.0 สูงสุด 15s/4K/9-3-3 refs; 2.5 สูงสุด 30s/720p/30-10-10 refs และรองรับ extension ต่อเนื่อง.

providerOptions.ltx25.help: LTX 2.5 Cloud และ Local มี capability ต่างกัน: Cloud รองรับ T2V/I2V/A2V, Start/Last, native multi-shot/audio แต่ไม่มี 2.5 Retake/Extend/Reframe; Local รองรับ official ComfyUI/Python workflows และ reference/extension ขั้นสูงเฉพาะ workflow ที่ verify แล้ว.

agentRuntime.help: OpenAI Agents SDK is a bounded reasoning runtime only. SmartAIHub Core owns state, credits, approvals, paid generation and publishing.

conditionalRules.when: assets contains role=start_frame
conditionalRules.then: show startFrameAnalysis + use authoritative State #0

conditionalRules.when: dialogue.lines length > 0
conditionalRules.then: require speaker mapping before prompt engineering

conditionalRules.when: modelRouting.requireLipSync == true
conditionalRules.then: filter routing to native or external lip-sync capable pipelines

conditionalRules.when: shot risk == high
conditionalRules.then: show safer-plan recommendation before generation

conditionalRules.when: product mechanism contains hidden or invisible stage
conditionalRules.then: require visual explanation strategy or explicit decision to explain by dialogue/VO only

conditionalRules.when: product category is cleaning_surface
conditionalRules.then: require target surface + correct application sequence + proof moment; consider cleaning_lift/before_after visualization

conditionalRules.when: product contains internal moving mechanism
conditionalRules.then: consider cutaway/motion_trace/xray-style explanation and validate mechanism facts before visualization

conditionalRules.when: product affects air/temperature/humidity
conditionalRules.then: use supported explanatory airflow/thermal visualization; do not present illustrative particles as literal measured output

conditionalRules.when: product is phone/tablet/computer/display device
conditionalRules.then: prefer exact UI/virtual screen compositing in post when screen text or interface fidelity matters

conditionalRules.when: logical shot duration exceeds selected provider direct max
conditionalRules.then: plan extension chain when verified; otherwise split shot or route model

conditionalRules.when: format.multiShotStrategy = extension_chain
conditionalRules.then: show base prompt plus each extension prompt with local and global timecodes

conditionalRules.when: provider extension tail may be rewritten
conditionalRules.then: avoid exact UI/label/dialogue word boundaries near extension seam and require seam QC

conditionalRules.when: target duration cannot be reached exactly
conditionalRules.then: show nearest reachable duration and require user/policy decision before paid generation

conditionalRules.when: MiniMax-H3 selected and raw image/video/audio references exist
conditionalRules.then: run H3 reference semantic mapping before prompt compilation

conditionalRules.when: MiniMax-H3 request contains start_frame/end_frame plus raw reference image/video/audio
conditionalRules.then: do not build one mixed API request; require explicit H3 conflict resolution

conditionalRules.when: MiniMax-H3 target duration > 15 seconds and continuity is required
conditionalRules.then: plan independent clips or a Ref2VA reference-video continuation chain; never label this as native append extension

conditionalRules.when: MiniMax-H3 dialogue language is outside the stable language list
conditionalRules.then: use native_try_then_external_fallback and perform speech/lipsync QC at 768P before 2K finalization

conditionalRules.when: MiniMax-H3 exact label/UI/CTA fidelity is required
conditionalRules.then: prefer clean generated plate plus post composite after temporal generation

conditionalRules.when: no product_reference exists and idea clearly refers to a physical product
conditionalRules.then: resolve whether product visual identity is generic, visible in another scene asset, researchable, or exact identity is blocked until a reference is supplied

conditionalRules.when: environment/place image is the subject of praise, tour, review, recommendation or visit
conditionalRules.then: reclassify the image as place/venue source-of-truth evidence, not only environment_reference

conditionalRules.when: place/venue branch has only one view
conditionalRules.then: do not invent unseen rooms/facilities as factual; use visible-area shots, derived crops, presenter movement, research-verified facts, or request more views

conditionalRules.when: named product has no product image and exact packaging/logo is required
conditionalRules.then: do not hallucinate exact visual identity; require source-of-truth asset or verified external asset

conditionalRules.when: generic product has no image and exact brand identity is not required
conditionalRules.then: allow a generic/unbranded product visual and mark visualIdentityStatus=generic_allowed

conditionalRules.when: no commercial target is detected
conditionalRules.then: use narrative_only branch and do not force product mechanics or CTA

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 selected and a Start Frame exists with no reference-to-video inputs
conditionalRules.then: route to image_to_video and treat the image as literal frame 0

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 selected and reference images or preset voices exist without a Start Frame
conditionalRules.then: route to reference_to_video; show that references guide identity/style but do not lock frame 0

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 has Start Frame plus reference images or reference voices
conditionalRules.then: block direct mixed request and require prefer_start_frame, prefer_references, prebake_start_frame, split_generation, or block

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 reference_to_video requests 1080p
conditionalRules.then: reject or change to 720p; never claim 1080p reference-to-video

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 receives a reference video
conditionalRules.then: do not pass it as reference-to-video input; derive motion/camera guidance, route fallback provider, or block according to policy

conditionalRules.when: grok-imagine-video-1.5 uses an authoritative Start Frame whose aspect differs from output
conditionalRules.then: prefer pre-normalizing crop/pad/resize before API submission rather than provider stretching

conditionalRules.when: a user-uploaded custom voice reference is intended for Grok 1.5 but trusted-partner entitlement is not verified
conditionalRules.then: route to external voice/lipsync or block; do not invent unsupported reference_audios payload

conditionalRules.when: Wan 3.0 has first_frame/last_frame plus reference image/video/audio/file/link
conditionalRules.then: never construct one mixed raw request; require explicit hard-frame/reference conflict resolution

conditionalRules.when: Wan 3.0 contains reference video and duration is exact
conditionalRules.then: require video duration metadata and validate total input-video duration + output duration <=30 seconds

conditionalRules.when: Wan 3.0 has 2+ storyboard shots
conditionalRules.then: allow provider-native timestamped multi-shot planning, typically 4-6 seconds per shot

conditionalRules.when: FLUX 3 receives a Start Frame
conditionalRules.then: map it to i2v keyframes at t=0; do not use a separate fictitious first_frame API field

conditionalRules.when: FLUX 3 receives character/product/place reference images that are not intended as literal timeline frames
conditionalRules.then: prebake them into approved shot keyframes, derive prompt guidance, route fallback, or block according to policy

conditionalRules.when: FLUX 3 receives arbitrary motion/reference video
conditionalRules.then: do not call it generic video reference; only v2v start_video continuation is currently public, otherwise derive/fallback

conditionalRules.when: Seedance 2.0 has audio refs but no image/video reference
conditionalRules.then: block because Seedance 2.0 audio-only reference is unsupported

conditionalRules.when: Seedance 2.5 is selected
conditionalRules.then: cap direct generation at 30s and resolution at 720p; allow up to 30 image / 10 video / 10 audio references

conditionalRules.when: Seedance 2.0 is selected
conditionalRules.then: cap direct generation at 15s; allow up to 9 image / 3 video / 3 audio refs; 4K is available but 1080p is invalid in reference-image scenarios

conditionalRules.when: BytePlus Seedance input image/video contains a real human face
conditionalRules.then: require an approved LAS material-library asset ID before raw provider submission

conditionalRules.when: Seedance hard Start/End Frame and arbitrary multimodal refs are both present and direct mix is not explicitly verified
conditionalRules.then: use prebake/split/prefer policy; fail closed rather than assume the endpoint supports the mix

conditionalRules.when: LTX 2.5 cloud is selected with Start Frame
conditionalRules.then: route to image-to-video; the Start Frame is image_uri and literal frame 0

conditionalRules.when: LTX 2.5 cloud has Start + Last Frame
conditionalRules.then: route to image-to-video with last_frame_uri and require fixed duration; automatic duration is invalid

conditionalRules.when: LTX 2.5 cloud receives generic character/product/place reference images
conditionalRules.then: do not send them as a fictitious soft-reference array; prebake into an approved first frame, derive to prompt, use verified local IC-LoRA, fallback, or block

conditionalRules.when: LTX Audio-to-Video is selected
conditionalRules.then: require exactly one explicit audio driver; treat it as the real soundtrack/timing source, not a voice embedding

conditionalRules.when: LTX cloud receives arbitrary raw video reference or must-use-raw generic audio reference
conditionalRules.then: route local verified workflow/fallback or block; cloud 2.5 has no generic video/audio reference bundle

conditionalRules.when: LTX cloud model/resolution/fps/duration combination is illegal
conditionalRules.then: reject before credit reservation / provider submission

conditionalRules.when: LTX 2.5 cloud Extend/Retake/Reframe is requested
conditionalRules.then: block/fallback because the current 2.5 model matrix marks these endpoints unsupported

conditionalRules.when: LTX local IC-LoRA or extension mode is requested
conditionalRules.then: require explicit local workflow ID/capability verification; do not assume every IC-LoRA from older LTX versions is 2.5-compatible

conditionalRules.when: LTX native multi-shot is used
conditionalRules.then: compile chronological prose with explicit cut transitions, repeated subject identity, and audio-continuity language rather than a screenplay-style numbered shot list
